promises.quote: Based on this review the Clinical Navigator will make a decision as to whether the call (1) needs to be upgraded immediately, (2) should remain as a category 3 response and await ambulance dispatch accordingly or (3) requires further triaging. This is now the first line of clinician review in these types of calls and ordinarily takes place within 15 minutes of the 999 call being concluded.
